Subject: Need help with a consumer complaint case

Hello, my name is Ravi Kurian. I am a 72-year-old pharmacist living in New Delhi. I paid Everest Builders Pvt Ltd Rs 4,49,00,000 for a flat, and the flat was handed over with serious construction defects. Can your firm advise me on what to do next? You can call me on 09359257989 or email ravi.kurian9@example.com.
